thread:
maya: Heads-up: rolling out autoscale policy change to 'cobalt' dedicated pool tonight 23:00 PT. Target window 23:00-00:30. Need smoke coverage + rollback owner. @sam can you take rollback on-call?

sam: Yep I can handle rollback. What's the exact change?

maya: Increase min_replicas from 2 -> 4, reduce smoothing_window to 15s, enable burst_capacity: true. Config diff below:
```yaml
policy:
  min_replicas: 4
  smoothing_window_s: 15
  burst_capacity: true
```
We'll flip via feature flag 'cobalt-autoscale-v2'.

jon: I'll run the smoke script and watch latency/queue_depth. What endpoints should I test?

priya: Focus on /v1/generate (latency tail), /health, and console metrics for pool 'cobalt'. Also check model KV cache hit rate after priming.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window at 2026-03-17T23:00:00-07:00 (23:00 PT).

jon: Plan: preflight at 22:45 PT — run ./scripts/smoke_cobalt.sh (sanity + sample generations), then enable flag in canary 10% for 10m. If no regressions, progressive 25/50/100 over 5m steps.

priya: If we see tail latency > 350ms or error rate > 0.5% in any step, rollback immediately. Rollback command is:
```bash
./scripts/rollback_autoscale.sh --pool cobalt --to v2.3.1
```

maya: Also have a quick perf check: watch GPU utilization and batching efficiency. If per-token cost spikes > 12% pause rollout.

sam: I'll be monitoring. I'll claim rollbacks. Ping me on this thread or @sam if I don't respond in 2m.

jon: :thumbsup: I'll post results in this thread. I'll capture console links and timestamps.

maya: Preflight checklist: 1) smoke script pass 2) canary 10% 3) perf thresholds ok 4) docs note updated. I updated PR #4823 with the change.

priya: ACK. I'll update the runbook with new thresholds and add eviction guard for low mem.

ops-bot: Deployment started: feature-flag cobalt-autoscale-v2 -> 10% canary. Link: https://console/redwood/deployments/3712345678

jon: Smoke run: 22:49 PT. All samples ok. Latency p50 85ms p95 240ms p99 330ms. No errors.

maya: Proceeding to 25% in 5m.

ops-bot: Progression to 25% complete.

jon: At 25% p99 creeping to 380ms on one node. Investigating batch sizes and queue depth.

priya: Noted. Can you check KV cache warming? Run a few long prompts to prime.

jon: Primed KV cache, p99 back to 320ms. Monitoring for 10m.

maya: Keep rolling if stable. Reminder: if spike again, rollback is immediate. Thanks all.

ops-bot: Deployment complete: cobalt-autoscale-v2 -> 100% (rolled 25->50->100).

jon: Final check: p99 310ms, error rate 0.02%. No regressions seen.

sam: :heavy_check_mark: rollback owner confirms no rollback needed. Will follow up if late issues.

maya: I'll file post-deploy note in #eng-releases and update release notes. Nice job.
